about: The known speech of `./bbox meet verify --call` (apps/meet/qa/verify_call.py, FPG-87): what the synthetic host says, and the words each of the office's two recognisers must write for it. One rendition = 1 s of silence, the Hebrew (he.ogg), 0.7 s, the English (spoken by flite inside the test container), 0.7 s; it is repeated for --speak seconds, then the microphone gives digital silence (the silent-mic guard's case 3). A word is found when the transcript, without niqqud and punctuation, CONTAINS it (a Hebrew prefix may be glued on).
